record.paper_title: Conjectures and Open Questions on the Structure and Regularity of Spaces with Lower Ricci Curvature Bounds
record.original_question: Let γ : (−2, 2) → X be a minimizing geodesic in a lower-Ricci limit space. For s, t ∈ (−1, 1), does the normalized volume ratio along γ satisfy a Lipschitz estimate of the form ν(B_r(γ(s))) / ν(B_r(γ(t))) ≤ C(n, λ)|t − s|? In the noncollapsed case, is the infinitesimal density constant along γ in the sense that lim_{r→0} ν(B_r(γ(s))) / ν(B_r(γ(t))) = 1?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.3. Let γ : (−2, 2) → X be a minimizing geodesic, then for s, t ∈ (−1, 1) we have that 1) (Lipschitz rate) ν(Br(γ(s)))/ν(Br(γ(t))) ≤ C(n, λ)|t − s|, 2) (constant density) if X is noncollapsed, then limr→0 ν(Br(γ(s)))/ν(Br(γ(t))) = 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setting. Let $n\ge 2$ and $\lambda\in\mathbb{R}$. Let $(X,d,\nu)$ be a metric measure space arising as a (pointed) measured Gromov–Hausdorff limit of a sequence of complete $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds $(M_i^n,g_i,\mathrm{vol}_{g_i}/\mathrm{vol}_{g_i}(B_1(p_i)))$ with $\mathrm{Ric}_{g_i}\ge -(n-1)\lambda$ (a Ricci limit space of dimension $\le n$). Call $X$ noncollapsed if it is a noncollapsed Ricci limit, equivalently if $\nu=\mathcal{H}^n$ up to a constant.

For $x\in X$ and $r>0$, write $B_r(x)$ for the open metric ball of radius $r$ around $x$, and let $\nu(B_r(x))$ denote its measure.

Let $\gamma:(-2,2)\to X$ be a unit-speed minimizing geodesic.

Question. Prove or disprove the following two statements.

(1) (Lipschitz volume-ratio bound) There exists a constant $C=C(n,\lambda)>0$ such that for all $r\in(0,1)$ and all $s,t\in(-1,1)$,
$$\frac{\nu(B_r(\gamma(s)))}{\nu(B_r(\gamma(t)))}\le 1+C(n,\lambda)\,|t-s|,$$
i.e. the function $s\mapsto \nu(B_r(\gamma(s)))$ is, up to ratios, Lipschitz along $\gamma$ with constants depending only on $n$ and $\lambda$.

(2) (Constant infinitesimal density) If in addition $X$ is noncollapsed, then for all $s,t\in(-1,1)$,
$$\lim_{r\to 0^+}\frac{\nu(B_r(\gamma(s)))}{\nu(B_r(\gamma(t)))}=1.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return a definitive resolution (positive or negative) of this conjecture on Lipschitz volume-ratio control and constancy of infinitesimal density along minimizing geodesics in lower-Ricci limit (or RCD) spaces. Related developments on noncollapsed RCD spaces, rectifiability of singular sets, and continuity of density along geodesic interiors exist, but none of the located sources state a complete proof or disproof of both parts of this specific conjecture. Status is therefore recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Non-collapsed spaces with Ricci curvature bounded from below
status_evidence.snippet: Study of noncollapsed RCD spaces, density properties and structure of singular sets, related to but not resolving the stated geodesic volume-ratio conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Provides background on density and noncollapsed structure but does not establish the Lipschitz volume-ratio bound along geodesics.

status_evidence.title: On the structure of RCD spaces with upper curvature bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Examines continuity of same-scale tangent cones along interiors of geodesics in RCD spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Addresses continuity-type behavior along geodesics under additional curvature assumptions, not the general Lipschitz/constant-density conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Rectifiability of singular sets of noncollapsed limit spaces with Ricci curvature bounded below
status_evidence.snippet: Rectifiability and structural results in noncollapsed Ricci limit spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Provides structural tools but does not resolve the conjectured volume-ratio Lipschitz estimate or constant infinitesimal density along geodesics.
